document_title: Queue Mode and Batch Processing - User Experience
description: What you see and experience when processing multiple books at once
when_to_use_queue_mode: When you have many EPUB files to process and don't want to manually configure each one as it finishes

entering_queue_mode.from_command_line: Start the program with: python epub_project_manager.py --queue

step_1.what_you_do: Select option 1: 'Add new book to queue'
step_1.what_you_see: List of available EPUB files (same as normal mode)

configuration.what_happens: You configure the book the same way as normal mode:

step_3.what_you_see_after: '✅ Added to queue: The Uzumaki Legend (Chapters 1-25)'
step_3.if_yes: You go back to select another EPUB

flow: Add first book → Configure it → Added to queue
Add second book → Configure it → Added to queue
Add third book → Configure it → Added to queue
Say 'no' when asked to add more
Return to queue menu → Start processing

what_you_see: 2. One Piece SI - Become Pirate King

option_1_process_in_this_window.what_happens: The program processes all books one after another in the current terminal
option_1_process_in_this_window.what_you_see: Each book is processed completely before moving to the next
option_1_process_in_this_window.you_cannot: Close this window or your processing stops

option_2_spawn_worker.what_you_are_asked: 'Start a background worker to process the queue? (y/n)'

if_yes.what_happens: A new terminal window opens to process the queue
if_yes.what_you_see_in_original: '✅ Worker started in new terminal. You can close this window.'
if_yes.what_you_see_in_new_window: The worker terminal shows processing progress

option_2_spawn_worker.benefit: You can close the original window and the processing continues

worker_mode_processing.what_worker_does: Grabs jobs from the queue one at a time and processes them
when_job_completes: '📋 Moving to next job in queue...'

if_job_fails.what_happens: The job is marked as failed and worker moves to next job
what_you_see: '❌ Job failed: One Piece SI - Become Pirate King'
'   Error: TTS generation failed after 3 retries'
'📋 Moving to next job in queue...'
if_job_fails.failed_job_stays_in_queue: You can view failed jobs later and see what went wrong

while_worker_is_running.how: Open another terminal, run the program, go to queue manager
what_you_see: • Processing: 1 (One Piece SI by Worker PID 12345)

clear_completed.what_it_does: Removes all completed jobs from the queue list
clear_completed.why: Keeps your queue clean and easy to read

remove_job.what_you_do: Type the number of the job to remove

what_this_means.survives_restart: If you close the program, your queue is preserved
what_this_means.can_add_anytime: You can add more jobs while worker is running
what_this_means.shared_between_windows: Multiple terminals can see the same queue

running_worker_at_startup.what_this_does: Starts directly in worker mode, immediately begins processing queue

stale_job_cleanup.what_this_means: If a job shows 'processing' but the worker crashed
stale_job_cleanup.what_you_see: '⚠️ Found stale job: Last worker (PID 12345) is no longer running'
stale_job_cleanup.automatic_action: The job is reset to 'pending' so it can be picked up again
